column3: “I returned and I lifted up my eyes” is rendered “I lifted up my eyes again.”
“Winds” is rendered “spirits”; “from presenting themselves on” is rendered “after standing before.”
“Which with it” is rendered “with one of which”; “to after them” is rendered “after them.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Go about” is rendered “patrol,” and “sought to go” “were eager to go”; NASB adds “When.”
“Caused my spirit to rest” is rendered “have appeased My wrath.”
NASB supplies “an offering” and “enter”; “who have come” is rendered “where they have arrived.”
“Crowns” (plural) is rendered “an ornate crown,” and “the great priest” “the high priest.”
“From under him he will sprout” is rendered “He will branch out from where He is”; NASB capitalizes “He.”
“Majesty” is rendered “the honor,” and “between the two of them” “between the two offices”; NASB supplies “offices” and adds “Yes” and “Thus.”
“Crowns” is rendered “crown,” and “memorial” “reminder”; NASB moves the names after “temple of the LORD.”
“Certainly listen to the voice” is rendered “completely obey.”
